Hall of Sorrow (su) Once every 1d4+1 rounds, as a standard action, Odin releases a magical beam around himself with his blade hitting all within a 120-ft.-radius. Everyone in the radius takes 8d6 points of non-elemental damage must make a Reflex save (DC 25) for half damage.

Hall of Stone (su) Once every 1d4+1 rounds, as a swift action, Odin drops down five random 20-ft.-radius dark circles upon his opponents. The following round, these circles explode doing 10d6 points of shadow damage per circle and inflicting the Petrification status effect. With each circle an opponent is within must make a Fortitude save (DC 25) per circle for half damage and negating the status effect.

Sanngetall (ex) Once every 1d4+4 rounds, as a standard action, Odin strikes with great power towards one opponent within melee range. If he hits (+27) [critical hits included], This attack does 12d8 points of slashing damage.

Shin-Zantetsuken (su) Once a day under 20% health (71 hp) or after 15 rounds, as a full-round action, Odin charges up during his first round then releases a deadly slash the following round killing all those whom attacked him unless they're immune to death status effect then it does 15d8 points of slashing damage unless they make a Fortitude save (DC 25) for half damage.

Valknut (su) Once every 1d6+2 rounds, Odin charges up for one full-round, then releases a powerful dark energy with a swift action the following round within 60-ft.-radius from himself. Everyone within the radius takes 15d8 points of (half shadow/non-elemental) damage must make a Reflex save (DC 25) for half damage.

parsed.description: A fell knight clad all in black, Odin roams paths long forgotten beneath the canopy of the Black Shroud. There are none now alive who know the truth of when or by whom this elder primal was first summoned into the world. Ever vigilant as he sits astride his mighty steed, Sleipnir, it is said that Odin is driven solely by the desire to do battle with worthy foes.

curation.summary: Odin, the Soul Reaper is packaged as an FFD20 NPC actor with 32 generated item(s) across 8 populated mechanics categories.
rulesDecisions: Actor data preserves the source statblock in biography and builder flags before any Foundry runtime hydration.
Only true feats, spells, and inventory placeholders are eligible for compendium lookup during import; creature-specific special abilities remain custom generated features.
Racial hit dice are generated from the creature type and source hit dice instead of creating class levels.
Source defensive text is mapped into FFD20 trait fields while unusual FF defenses remain preserved as custom text.
Natural attack items use source attack totals, source damage dice, and manual extra attacks for full-attack routines.
Skill ranks are reverse-calculated from source totals after ability modifiers, racial modifiers, size modifiers, and class-skill bonuses.
